description: This file contains utility classes and functions for handling encrypted database fields, including encryption type definitions, adapters, a factory for creating encrypted fields, and a migrator for re-encrypting existing data in a SQLAlchemy-managed database.

classes.name: EncryptedType
classes.description: A custom SQLAlchemy type extending EncryptedType with cache optimization.

classes.name: AbstractEncryptedFieldAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for encrypted field adapters.

classes.name: SQLAlchemyUtilsAdapter
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the adapter interface for SQLAlchemy's EncryptedType.

classes.name: EncryptedFieldFactory
classes.description: Factory class to initialize and create encrypted field types based on app configuration.

classes.name: SecretsMigrator
classes.description: Class responsible for discovering encrypted fields and re-encrypting data with a new secret key.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an encrypted type instance, using app config if available.

methods.name: init_app
methods.description: Initializes the factory with a Flask app's configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an encrypted field adapter instance.

methods.name: created_by_enc_field_factory
methods.description: Checks if a field was created by the encrypted field factory.

methods.name: discover_encrypted_fields
methods.description: Discovers all encrypted fields in the database schema.

methods.name: _read_bytes
methods.description: Converts database column values to bytes for decryption.

methods.name: _select_columns_from_table
methods.description: Selects specified columns from a table.

methods.name: _re_encrypt_row
methods.description: Re-encrypts a database row with a new secret key.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs the re-encryption process on all discovered encrypted fields.
